projects.name: Moss Landing Power Plant battery ESS
projects.quote: In June 2023, an additional 350 MW battery ESS at our Moss Landing Power Plant site commenced commercial operations.

projects.name: Illinois solar photovoltaic facilities at retired plant sites
projects.quote: We continued development and construction activities on the planned development of up to 300 MW of solar photovoltaic power generation facilities and up to 150 MW of battery ESS at retired or to-be-retired plant sites in Illinois.

projects.name: Illinois battery ESS at retired plant sites

projects.name: Energy Harbor acquisition
projects.quote: We expect to use cash on hand and borrowings under the Receivables Facility and Repurchase Facility and other liquidity facilities to fund the approximately $3.1 billion cash necessary to close the Energy Harbor acquisition.
